claims.text: The number of clusters used in word vector models was varied, with optimal results generally found between 250 and 1000 classes.
Different types of features were extracted, including n-grams, part-of-speech tags, and sentiment scores.
The experiments involved varying the number of classes for the classification task, with better performance observed at higher numbers of classes (1000 or 2000).
